ops.text:
20. INDEMNIFICATION
20.1 Vendor shall defend and indemnify Customer and its Affiliates against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
20.2 Customer's indemnity obligations under this Agreement are limited to third-party claims arising out of (a) content or materials provided by Customer to Vendor; or (b) Customer's breach of Applicable Law.
20.3 The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of the claim; the indemnifying Party shall have control of the defence of the claim; and the indemnified Party shall provide reasonable cooperation.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no indemnity at all, although Sections 9.3, 19.4, 21.3 and 30.5 already assume one, so we inserted a new Section 20 with Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused Customer Data breaches and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, a notice/control/cooperation procedure, and Customer's indemnity confined to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law. This is our preferred position; we can discuss the fallback (Vendor IP indemnity with the customary exclusions, procure/modify/replace/refund remedies and a 3x annual-fees super-cap) if helpful.
proposal.summary: Insert a concise new Section 20 (Indemnification) at the preferred position: Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates for IP, breach-of-law, data-breach and misconduct claims, with notice/control/cooperation procedure and a narrow Customer indemnity.
